paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.89% on average, with DAX strongest (+2.84%) and Dow Jones weakest (-0.99%). Brent crude changed -2.71% to 113.56. Gold changed -0.50% to 3,988.0. Bitcoin changed -3.03% to 77,599.9922. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.989%, a relative move of +0.73%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+16.52%) and Deutsche Bank (+10.74%) moved the most.
